seasonal_event_tu_wz330/ftue_desc_1: Godzilla and Kong are unleashed on the island! Be wary, the arrogance of man is thinking nature is in their control.
seasonal_event_tu_wz330/ftue_desc_2: Monarch has setup camp to research the Titans. Collect Intel from Kills, Contracts, Crates, or by shooting the Titans to gain a Titan S.C.R.E.A.M. Device killstreak capable of directing the Titans' wrath.
seasonal_event_tu_wz330/ftue_desc_3: The Titan S.C.R.E.A.M. Device is still a prototype and can send the Titans into a deadly frenzy. Stagger the Titans with heavy weaponry and Monarch may compensate you.
seasonal_event_tu_wz330/mendota_descript: Totally a temp string. Fight monsters and get destroyed. Don't get stepped on. Save the world. Other words just to test a slightly longer and more descriptive text. AHHH Fake Monsters.
seasonal_event_tu_wz330/mendota_info_01: Intel is key. Gather intel to earn powerful rewards that can turn the tide of battle in your favor. The final reward is a single use of the unique Titan S.C.R.E.A.M. killstreak, capable of directing Titan attacks. Prove your valor by being the ^$last team standing^7 and the Titans may just spare you.
seasonal_event_tu_wz330/mendota_info_02: Intel can be collected as ^$Loot^7 from other players, as a reward for completing a ^$Contract^7, found in ^$Crates^7 scattered across Caldera, or by ^$shooting the Titans^7. Intel you earn will fill your Intel Meter and at certain milestones, rewards will be earned.
seasonal_event_tu_wz330/mendota_info_03: Operation Monarch begins as a Resurgence mode. As long as one player on your team remains alive, you will ^$respawn after a short delay^7. Resurgence will disable after circle five, at which point it's all down to the last team standing.
seasonal_event_tu_wz330/mendota_info_04: During the Titan Frenzy event, your goal is to ^$stagger the Titans^7. Heavy Weapon Drops will be released throughout the map to help with this. You'll need to get close to penetrate their defenses, but unique rewards should make the risk worth it.
seasonal_event_tu_wz330/mendota_info_05: The Titan S.C.R.E.A.M. Device (Sonic Communication Radar and Echolocation Array Module) is a prototype that seems to be capable of ^$directing the Titan's attacks^7, though it is unclear why. If you earn enough Intel to advance the research of the device, you'll be granted a one time use that will allow you to direct Kong or Godzilla to attack the location of your choice. Use it wisely.
seasonal_event_tu_wz330/mendota_playlist: Kings will collide in the ultimate battle royale. Gather intel to power up and gain access to a top secret prototype killstreak.
